# early-init.el

- Place early-init.el in \~/.emacs.d/

```default
;;; early-init.el --- Early initialization

;;; Commentary:
;; Startup settings that must be applied before init.el and the first frame.

;;; Code:

;; Startup GC
(setq gc-cons-threshold most-positive-fixnum
      gc-cons-percentage 0.6)

;; Package initialization
(setq package-enable-at-startup nil)

;; Native compilation warnings
(setq native-comp-async-report-warnings-errors nil)

;; Prevent frame resizing during startup
(setq frame-inhibit-implied-resize t)

;; Optional: disable UI elements before the first frame
;; (menu-bar-mode -1)
;; (tool-bar-mode -1)
;; (scroll-bar-mode -1)

(provide 'early-init)

;;; early-init.el ends here
```
